nodes.definition: Average paid cost per closed claim
Closed claims per 1,000 earned exposure units
Incurred losses divided by earned premium

nodes.name: OEM parts inflation
nodes.evidence: OEM replacement parts price index rose +9.2% in 2024 and a further +4.6% in 2025 (cumulative ≈ +14.2%).

provenance.title: OEM Parts Price Bulletin
provenance.quote: OEM replacement parts prices rose +9.2% during 2024 and a further +4.6% in 2025

nodes.name: ADAS repair complexity
nodes.evidence: ADAS-equipped vehicles cost ≈22% more to repair than non-ADAS equivalents, and their share of repairable vehicles rose from 45% to 61% over the period.

provenance.title: Repair Network Cost Study
provenance.quote: ADAS sensor suites cost approximately 22% more to repair ... rose from 45% to 61% of the repairable fleet

nodes.name: Parts supply-chain friction
nodes.evidence: Average parts delivery delay peaked at 9.1 days in 2024Q2 and remains 6.3 days; supplement handling adds ≈ $180 per claim.

provenance.title: Repair Network Cost Study
provenance.quote: parts delivery delays peaked at 9.1 days in 2024Q2 and remain at 6.3 days

provenance.title: Collision Parts Vendor Newsletter
provenance.quote: supplement volumes remain elevated, adding roughly $180 per claim

nodes.name: Medical cost inflation
nodes.evidence: Medical care CPI rose ≈18% cumulatively between 2023Q1 and 2025Q4, flowing directly into bodily-injury settlement values.

provenance.title: Actuarial Trend Selection Memo — Q1
provenance.quote: Medical care CPI has risen approximately 18% cumulatively since 2023Q1

nodes.name: Litigation climate (Northeast)
nodes.evidence: Northeast attorney-representation rate on BI claims climbed from 48% to 57%; represented claims settle ≈25% higher than unrepresented ones.

provenance.title: Legal Operations Quarterly Review
provenance.quote: Attorney representation rates on Northeast BI claims climbed from 48% to 57%

nodes.name: Catastrophe weather event
nodes.evidence: A hurricane made landfall in the South region in 2024Q3; auto claim counts spiked +18% that quarter and +10% in 2024Q4 before normalizing.

provenance.title: Catastrophe Event Report — 2024Q3 Hurricane
provenance.quote: Auto claim counts spiked +18% in 2024Q3 and +10% in 2024Q4 before normalizing

nodes.name: Miles driven (VMT)
nodes.evidence: Vehicle-miles traveled grew +2.1% year over year — mild upward pressure on accident frequency everywhere.

provenance.title: Mobility & Exposure Digest
provenance.quote: Vehicle-miles traveled grew +2.1% year over year

nodes.name: Winter storm (episodic)
nodes.evidence: A polar vortex in 2025Q1 lifted Midwest frequency +6% for one quarter only; no persistent effect.

provenance.title: Winter Operations Flash — Polar Vortex
provenance.quote: The January polar vortex lifted Midwest auto frequency by about +6% for 2025Q1 only
